lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of structured nodal points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on their superior edges and distinct shadow gradients on their inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density patterning of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and more frequent than the primary blobs on the lateral flank.
